about.title: Design that speaks before you say a word.
about.name: MUGABO Robert
about.paragraph1: Hey, I'm Robert — a graphic designer and UI designer based in Kigali, Rwanda, working professionally under the name EL-VERBUENA.
about.paragraph2: I design logos, business cards, flyers, song covers, packaging and digital interfaces. My goal with every project is simple: make your brand look so good that people stop scrolling.
about.paragraph3: I've worked with startups, artists, tech companies and entrepreneurs across Rwanda and beyond. Whether you need a full brand identity or a single flyer, I bring the same care and attention to every piece.
